text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: C390 · Listing 9.1 — FDTD simulation of a directional coupler → S-parameters

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Chapter 9 — Photonic circuit modelling · Sec. 9.7 Code listings (book p. 333) · Lumerical FDTD script

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: Step 1 — choose the design and open an output table

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Names the design knobs (gap, radius, width, height, length, etch); opens an XML table.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Listing defaults: 200 nm gap, 5 µm radius, 500 × 220 nm waveguide, point coupling (Lc = 0).

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: Step 2 — draw the coupler (see C375, Fig. 9.3)

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Top: quarter-ring arcs with straight exits. Below the gap: a curved coupler with 30° bends.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Adds a partly etched Si slab (130 nm etch → 90 nm slab), buried oxide and oxide cladding.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff
font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Places mode sources at ports 1 and 2, and power + mode-expansion monitors at all four ports.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: For the finer mesh settings, adds a finer mesh just around the narrow coupling gap.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: Step 4 — two runs give eight S-parameters (see C376, C377)

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Run 1: light in at port 1 → S11, S21, S31, S41. Run 2: light in at port 2 → S12 … S42.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Symmetry fills in the other eight (with sign flips from the FDTD field sign convention).

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff
font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Tests the 4×4 matrix per frequency: warns if not passive, or reciprocity is off by > 5 %.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Writes a .sparam file, a text summary, and centre through/cross power and loss to the XML.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: S-parameter = complex number (amplitude + phase): light leaving one port per light entering another.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #30d158

g.text: Takeaway: build → simulate twice → use symmetry → sanity-check → export S-parameters for circuits.
